differences: The text gives mean total learning 36.21 deg and explicit learning 11.51 deg; the shared data give 36.23 and 11.49 (the same values the authors' mwm.csv stores), while the reported SDs, t values and Cohen's d reproduce exactly. The t tests are reported with 29 degrees of freedom but reproduce with all 31 participants (30 df).

The Methods report 98 MWM trials excluded (|angular error| > 90 deg); the shared file lacks 129 of 31 x 96 trials, 96 of them before each participant's last shared trial (added here as placeholder rows) and 33 at block ends, so the excluded trials cannot be told apart from trials that were not recorded.
